scripts.build: tsc && vite build && vite build --config vite.content.config.ts && vite build --config vite.bridge.config.ts
scripts.build:chrome: npm run build && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('manifest.chrome.json', 'dist/manifest.json')" && node scripts/verify-classic-content-scripts.mjs dist
scripts.build:firefox: tsc && vite build --outDir dist-firefox && vite build --config vite.content.config.ts --outDir dist-firefox && vite build --config vite.bridge.config.ts --outDir dist-firefox && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('manifest.firefox.json', 'dist-firefox/manifest.json')" && node scripts/verify-classic-content-scripts.mjs dist-firefox
